summary: The bounded 163-token, Light/Dark, six-family/44-variant foundation is coherent with the approved workbench UX and current plan. Repo tokens, CSS, semantic roles, states, typography, layout, motion, focus, and permission/recovery guidance are implementation-ready for this foundation. The Figma file is recorded in the dedicated project; inventory/audit show 163 variables, five styles, 44 variants and editable text properties. I viewed final Foundations, all six family screenshots, and DarkPermission: content is legible, focus rings visible, paths wrap, and no material clipping is evident. The corrected approved permission badge is blue/info in source and capture; exact live export binding evidence ties Status 8:23 fill to VariableID:3:88 and label 8:24 to VariableID:3:89, while copy says decision delivered rather than execution complete. Both declared validators pass.

evidence_limits: Static captures and recorded Figma exports do not prove keyboard, screen-reader, responsive runtime, or live app behavior; the app is not implemented.
